activity_summary: Hobbins looked in after dinner and set the morning at six, at the bridge. Six horses and a spare. You are to ride the spare as far as Shipston, ten miles, and carry nothing, and he would not hear the back argue. The pack and the saddle are two shillings, to be paid at the Bell. Richard has the pack by the stair. Anne said you had packed before the evening could arrange itself. The inkhorn was not in the pack.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Accepted six, the spare, and payment at the Bell, and then missed the inkhorn.

entities.name: Thomas Hobbins
entities.context: Set the string, the ten miles, the two shillings, and the pace.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Told him he would be proud on the horse, and sent him after the horn.

entities.name: Richard Shakespeare
entities.context: Had the pack by the stair, and refused to hunt the horn in the dark.
